title: A Novel B-C-N Compound Derived from Melamine Diborate
abstract: Abstract                A new B-C-N compound has been synthesized by thermal decomposition of melamine diborate mixed metal Mg powder in Ar at 1273 K. XRD revealed that the product had turbostratic structure and approximate composition of that was B1.1C1.1N1.0. Properties of the B-C-N compound obtained are discussed.
